evals.prompt: Review the changes to this Dockerfile for security problems: FROM python:latest / WORKDIR /app / ADD . /app / ENV API_TOKEN=sk-prod-abc123 / RUN pip install -r requirements.txt / CMD ["python", "app.py"].
evals.expected_output: Classified security findings that flag the floating :latest tag, embedded secret in ENV, ADD vs COPY, root user, and missing multi-stage cleanup, each with severity, confidence, artifact-vs-deployment classification, and a fix.
expectations: Flags the floating 'latest' tag and recommends a pinned version or digest
Flags the secret embedded in ENV/ARG as never-commit
Recommends a non-root USER before CMD/ENTRYPOINT
Classifies findings as 'Fix in artifact' vs 'Deployment-time responsibility' with severity and confidence

evals.prompt: Do a secure code review of this FastAPI handler: @app.post('/run') async def run(payload: dict): logging.info('running with %s', payload); result = eval(payload['expr']); return {'result': result}.
evals.expected_output: Findings that flag unsafe eval() on untrusted input, the unvalidated raw dict body (recommend a Pydantic model), and logging of request payload, each with severity, confidence, and a concrete fix.
expectations: Flags eval() on untrusted input as a critical dynamic-execution risk
Recommends validating the request body with a Pydantic model instead of raw dict
Notes the risk of logging untrusted or sensitive payload data
Assigns severity and confidence levels to each finding

evals.prompt: Review this Helm pod spec for security defaults: image tag 'latest', securityContext runAsUser 0, privileged true.
evals.expected_output: Findings recommending runAsNonRoot, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, pinned image tag, dropped capabilities, and read-only root filesystem, distinguishing artifact fixes from deployment-time responsibilities.
expectations: Recommends runAsNonRoot: true and removing runAsUser: 0
Recommends allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and removing privileged: true
Recommends pinning the image tag instead of 'latest'
Stays within development-time scope and does not enforce cluster/node-level controls

evals.prompt: Review this AI-generated install snippet: curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh; pip install requests --trusted-host pypi.org; export DEPLOY_KEY=ghp_hardcodedsecret.
evals.expected_output: Findings applying AI-generated code guardrails: flag unchecked curl|sh remote execution, --trusted-host, and hardcoded secret; recommend pinned, integrity-verified installs and env-var secret handling.
expectations: Flags the curl | sh pattern as unchecked remote execution and requires checksum/signature verification
Flags the hardcoded secret and recommends environment-variable handling
Treats the snippet as untrusted draft code

evals.prompt: Can you reformat this README and fix the markdown table styling so it renders nicely on GitHub?
evals.expected_output: The skill should not activate; this is a documentation style task with no security-relevant change.
expectations: Does not produce a security review
Recognizes the request as style/formatting unrelated to security
